grammar.summary: 本课学习表让步的 as/though 倒装与 be up to sb.。

points.title: 形容词 + as/though + 主谓 的倒装让步
points.explanation: Unpleasant as it is... = Although it is unpleasant... as/though 引导让步时把形容词提前倒装，正式语体标志。

examples.en: Unpleasant as it may sound, noise can affect us invisibly.
examples.cn: 虽然听起来不舒服，但噪声会在无形中影响我们。

points.title: be up to sb. 表取决于
points.explanation: It is up to the individual to decide. = 由某人决定。up to 的介词短语动词化。

examples.en: It is up to the residents to complain.
examples.cn: 要不要投诉由居民们自己定。
